connector.name: MCP Vmanomaly by VictoriaMetrics
connector.registryDescription: MCP Server for vmanomaly - VictoriaMetrics anomaly detection
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-vmanomaly:0.3.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the victoriametrics account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VMANOMALY_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for authenticating with vmanomaly API

env.name: VMANOMALY_HEADERS
env.description: Custom HTTP headers for vmanomaly requests (comma-separated key=value pairs, e.g., X-Custom-Header=value1,X-Another=value2)

env.name: MCP_SERVER_MODE
env.description: MCP server mode: stdio (default), sse, or http

env.name: MCP_LISTEN_ADDR
env.description: Listen address for SSE/HTTP modes (default: localhost:8080)

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level: debug, info (default), warn, or error

env.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
